items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And when I left Dreamland, I joined Jimmy's band. That was at Edelweiss.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band? You and Jimmy Noon and...

Jimmy Noon and Minor. Minor Hall, the drummer. And Baby Hall. One would play a week or four or five nights. Yeah. And you wouldn't see him anymore than his brother. Brother. And then we had Baby Dot there quite a long time, too. Johnny used to bring his clan out, too. Johnny was with Joe Oliver. Oh yeah. And he used to bring his clan out because he and Jimmy were very good friends. And he used to love to come out there and play. Ollie Powers. He used to do almost all the singing then, until he lost Baby, the Hall…
He was a good drummer, too.
